title: BattleReadyShelf Model Definition Export
description: The authoritative contract for the JSON document accepted by POST /api/v1/admin/model-definitions/import (and produced by GET /api/v1/admin/model-definitions/export). This is the canonical source of truth for this contract - other repositories producing an import document (e.g. battlereadyshelf-data / battlereadyshelf-dataset) must conform to it. It mirrors the 'ModelDefinitionExport' schema in backend/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml; if the two ever disagree, the OpenAPI spec wins and this file should be updated to match.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this export document's schema. Must equal the backend's currently supported version (see CURRENT_EXPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION in ModelDefinitionDraftService) or the import is rejected.

exportedAt.description: Set by the backend on export; ignored if present on import.

datasetVersion.description: Optional version of the source dataset assembled into this document.

factions.description: Factions referenced by 'modelDefinitions' below. Upserted by stable source id directly (no draft/publish workflow - factions carry no army-building rules, purely catalogue organisation/filtering).

id.description: Stable identifier used to match this faction across imports.

parentFactionId.description: The id of the parent faction (from this same 'factions' list), if any. Null/absent for a top-level faction.

id.description: Stable identifier used to match this model definition across imports instead of by name. Sourced from the reference dataset; exports of hand-authored definitions emit the persisted UUID instead.

factionId.description: The id of the faction (from this document's 'factions' list) this model belongs to. Null if uncategorised.

id.description: Stable identifier for this slot, used to match it across imports and by wargear slot references. Sourced from the reference dataset; exports of hand-authored slots emit the persisted UUID instead.

type.description: Stable machine-readable category for this physical attachment slot.

id.description: Stable identifier used to match this option across imports. Sourced from the reference dataset; exports of hand-authored options emit the persisted UUID instead.

isDefault.description: Whether this option is part of the model's default loadout.

slotIds.description: The id(s) of the attachment slot(s), from this same modelDefinitionExportItem's 'attachmentSlots', this option fills.
